facts.material: Lexan (polycarbonate) plastic housing; cast aluminum bracket
facts.function: housing/shell and mounting bracket of a traffic light
facts.end_use: traffic signal (electrical signalling equipment for roads)

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8530 covers electrical signalling equipment for roads; Section XVI note 2(b)/(a) and chapter 85 give parts suitable solely or principally for such equipment to the heading's Parts line

rejected_alternatives.reason: plastic articles; Section XVI parts of electrical signalling equipment take precedence (Sec. XVI note 1 does not exclude)
aluminum articles; bracket is a part principally used with traffic signals, so heading 8530 parts
vehicle lighting/signalling; traffic signals for roads are heading 8530

missing_facts: confirm parts are dedicated to traffic signals (not general fittings)
classification.rationale: Traffic signals are electrical signalling equipment for roads of heading 8530; parts solely or principally used with it go to 8530.90.00.00 per Section XVI note 2(b). CROSS search found no on-point ruling, so none cited.
